     \( \gamma = E/mc^2 = 27/3.41 \approx 7.928 \).  
   - If 27 GeV is **kinetic energy** \( K \):  
     \( E = K + mc^2 = 27 + 3.41 = 30.41 \, \text{GeV} \),  
     \( \gamma = 30.41/3.41 \approx 8.917 \).  

2. **Mean lifetime in lab frame**:  
   \( \tau = \gamma \tau_0 \).  
   - Total energy assumption: \( \tau \approx 7.928 \times 8 \times 10^{-16} \approx 6.34 \times 10^{-15} \, \text{s} \).  
   - Kinetic energy assumption: \( \tau \approx 8.917 \times 8 \times 10^{-16} \approx 7.13 \times 10^{-15} \, \text{s} \).  

3. **Required time resolution (\( \Delta t \)) for 30% decay observation**:  
   Solve \( 1 - e^{-\Delta t/\tau} = 0.3 \rightarrow \Delta t = -\tau \ln(0.7) \approx 0.3567 \tau \).
